items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I've heard of him, I never knew him. ... Rene would play a good little trumpet for him.

ctx.x: Who won? Did anybody tell who they thought was best?

Was it? You crowd, you see. He beat. Some guy pulled for Chris. But Rene had to pull a good pull over there because he used to live there on Cornice Street. Yeah. That was only a couple of blocks from his house. Yeah, all his friends. Yeah. We had some friends around there too.
Did Chris know many different pieces or did he stick mostly to blues? People tell me he was very good on blues. Did he know a lot of other numbers too? Or what all did you play in the band?
